security-reviewer.description: Read-only review for PII leakage, missing auth boundaries, secret hygiene, and span-attribute safety in this Bedrock-backed extraction service. Fire when touching extraction/service.py, api/routes.py, logging.py, or telemetry.py.

prompt-template-reviewer.description: Read-only review of src/bedrock_strands_agent/templates/*.j2 against six invariants (JSON contract, no-fences instruction, StrictUndefined safety, field-attribute injection completeness, retry-prompt errors+document injection, PII templating). Fire when changing any template.
